title: Native queued build reports failure after successful target summary when winjob reaps a leftover process
body: The first queued native Release build reached the vixen-native summary 'All targets built successfully' and exit code 0, but with-test-lock returned PAYLOAD_FAIL after winjob reported that it reaped one process the build left running. A queued incremental retry passed without source changes. The native build/queue contract should treat a successful target summary with only benign leftover-process cleanup as successful, or surface a precise ownership diagnostic so lanes do not need a retry.
